title: Optio: Ticket to merged PR orchestration for AI coding agents in K8s
description: System that turns tickets into merged pull requests using Claude Code or Codex. Includes CI check monitoring and self-healing loops for agent failures.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration (Microsoft OSS)
description: CLI to install and manage AI agent dependencies (plugins, skills, rules). Includes version pinning via lockfile and audits for hidden unicode/supply-chain attacks.

title: G0: Control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
description: Control layer for AI agents (LangChain, CrewAI, MCP). Static and behavioral analysis, adversarial red teaming, and runtime monitoring. Mentions first-class OpenClaw support.

title: Sally CLI: AI code reviewer with build gate support
description: AI code reviewer with --fail-under flag for build gates, ensuring AI-generated code meets quality standards before deployment.

title: Sweet! CLI: Autopilot for monitoring production deployments
description: AI agent CLI with 'autopilot' feature for monitoring live deployed applications and detecting outages.

title: Urlx: Agent-made Rust replacement for curl via TDD
description: Demonstrates that agents can reimplement complex, widely-deployed software (curl) in days when given a robust test suite as a specification.

title: SHTMLs: Autonomous self-configuration via llms.txt
description: Pastebin for HTML output where AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor) read llms.txt to self-configure and upload outputs autonomously.

title: UberSKILLS: Workbench for building and testing agent SKILL.md
description: Workbench for authoring, validating, and deploying Agent Skills (SKILL.md) to multiple agent runtimes.

title: Study: Counter-strategies for 'AI Slop' in pull requests
description: Developers are proposing size limits for AI-generated PRs, mandatory self-reviews, and tying accountability to performance reviews to combat low-quality AI code.

title: Claude Code CI Review and Triage
description: Official Claude Code documentation mentions CI automation for code review and issue triage using GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD.
